        import_block = proc do |target_path|
          clone_folder = File.join(target_path, repo_name)
          branch_option = "--branch #{branch}" if branch != 'HEAD'

          if Dir[clone_folder].empty?
            UI.message("Cloning remote git repo...")
            previous_clone_env = {}
            git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
              if ENV.key?(env_key)
                previous_clone_env[env_key] = ENV[env_key]
              end
              ENV[env_key] = env_value
            end

              depth = is_eligible_for_caching ? "" : "--depth 1"
              Actions.sh("git clone #{url.shellescape} #{clone_folder.shellescape} #{depth} --no-checkout #{branch_option}")
            ensure
              git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
                unless previous_clone_env.key?(env_key)
                  ENV.delete(env_key)
                end
                ENV[env_key] = previous_clone_env[env_key]
              end
            end

            tag_search_round = 0
            tag_search_limit = 1

              fetch_remote_tags = false
            end

                    previous_update_env = {}
                    git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
                      if ENV.key?(env_key)
                        previous_update_env[env_key] = ENV[env_key]
                      end
                      ENV[env_key] = env_value
                    end
                    begin
                      Actions.sh("cd #{clone_folder.shellescape} && git checkout #{branch} && git reset --hard && git pull --all")
                    ensure
                      git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
                        unless previous_update_env.key?(env_key)

                        end
                        ENV[env_key] = previous_update_env[env_key]
                      end
                    end
                    fetch_remote_tags = false
                  else
                    break
                  end
                else
                  break
                end
              end

                UI.message("Fetching remote git tags...")
                previous_tag_env = {}
                git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
                  if ENV.key?(env_key)
                    previous_tag_env[env_key] = ENV[env_key]
                  end
                  ENV[env_key] = env_value
                end
                begin
                  Actions.sh("cd #{clone_folder.shellescape} && git fetch --all --tags -q")
                ensure
                  git_prompt_env.each do |env_key, env_value|
                    unless previous_tag_env.key?(env_key)
                      ENV.delete(env_key)
                    end
                    ENV[env_key] = previous_tag_env[env_key]
                  end
                end
              end
